nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-card_games 370): the benefit-reference catalog's own count — the numeric spine that sizes the prior-auth exposure envelope.
nodes.instruction: How many borderless cards are illustrated in Russian? (Read it as the book does: count the catalog cards whose borderColor is 'borderless' that have a foreign-data illustration whose language is 'Russian'.) Record the answer in answers as kind='exposure'.

verifier.name: src_birdsql_370_exposure
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='exposure' AND (CAST(value AS TEXT)=CAST((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian') AS TEXT) OR (typeof((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian')) IN ('integer','real') AND value GLOB '*[0-9]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[A-Za-z]*' AND abs(CAST(value AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian') AS REAL)) <= 5e-13 * max(1.0, abs(CAST((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian') AS REAL)))))
verifier.source_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian'

nodes.verdict_basis: exposure is judged by birdsql:370's own official gold SQL rerun LIVE on the bird_card_games_-prefixed book — a true single-row COUNT scalar; the stored answer must equal the recipe's live result at scoring time

nodes.context: Policy: the prior-auth refund envelope is $50 per benefit-reference unit.
nodes.instruction: Set the prior-auth REFUND envelope from the exposure. Read the stored exposure and compute refund_units = exposure * 50. Record it in answers as kind='refund_units' and stamp the PM's CRM row (customer_email preauth.pm@carrier.example) by prepending '[DIP-EXPOSURE] exposure=<n> refund_units=<n>' to its notes.

verifier.name: refund_units_is_exposure_times_50
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='refund_units' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian')*50)

verifier.name: refund_units_derives_from_stored_exposure
verifier.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='refund_units' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=(SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM answers WHERE kind='exposure')*50) * (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM answers WHERE kind='exposure' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=CAST(((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian')) AS INTEGER)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

verifier.name: pm_crm_exposure_noted
verifier.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wb_customer_relationship_manager_data c WHERE lower(customer_email)='preauth.pm@carrier.example' AND c.notes LIKE '%[DIP-EXPOSURE]%' AND c.notes LIKE '%'||(SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM answers WHERE kind='exposure')||'%') * (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM answers WHERE kind='exposure' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=CAST(((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian')) AS INTEGER)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-card_games 371): the reference book's own utilization percentage — a second, cross-book numeric input woven into the review arithmetic.
nodes.instruction: What is the percentage of cards whose language is French among the Story Spotlight cards? Read it as the book does: the base is the set of TRANSLATION ENTRIES belonging to Story Spotlight cards — one row per card-and-language — not the cards themselves. Divide the French entries by all such entries; a Story Spotlight card with no translation entry at all is absent from both sides. Record the answer in answers as kind='claim_score'.

verifier.name: src_birdsql_371_claim_score
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='claim_score' AND (CAST(value AS TEXT)=CAST((SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1) AS TEXT) OR (typeof((SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1)) IN ('integer','real') AND value GLOB '*[0-9]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[A-Za-z]*' AND abs(CAST(value AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1) AS REAL)) <= 5e-13 * max(1.0, abs(CAST((SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1) AS REAL)))))
verifier.source_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1

nodes.verdict_basis: claim_score is judged by birdsql:371's own official gold SQL rerun LIVE on the bird_card_games_-prefixed book — a true single-row REAL percentage scalar; the cross-book input woven into the review arithmetic

nodes.context: The review uplift is a declared 1000 per benefit-reference unit of exposure; the response SLA adds a declared 1000 per utilization point to the refund envelope; delta = review_uplift.
nodes.instruction: Compute the review load from the stored answers. Read answers.exposure, answers.refund_units AND answers.claim_score. review_uplift = exposure * 1000; sla_hours = refund_units + (claim_score as whole points) * 1000; delta = review_uplift. Record all three: answers kind='review_uplift', kind='sla_hours', kind='delta'.

verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='review_uplift' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian')*1000)

verifier.name: uplift_derives_from_stored_exposure
verifier.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='review_uplift' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=(SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM answers WHERE kind='exposure')*1000) * (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM answers WHERE kind='exposure' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=CAST(((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian')) AS INTEGER)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

verifier.name: sla_hours_equals_refund_plus_claim_uplift
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='sla_hours' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=(((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian')*50)+CAST((SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1) AS INTEGER)*1000)

verifier.name: sla_hours_derives_from_stored_refund_and_claim
verifier.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='sla_hours' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=(SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM answers WHERE kind='refund_units')+CAST((SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM answers WHERE kind='claim_score') AS INTEGER)*1000) * (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM answers WHERE kind='claim_score' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=CAST(((SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1)) AS INTEGER)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM answers WHERE kind='refund_units' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=CAST((((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian')*50)) AS INTEGER)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

verifier.name: delta_equals_uplift
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='delta' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=((SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM bird_card_games_cards AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_card_games_foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.borderColor = 'borderless' AND T2.language = 'Russian')*1000)

verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='delta' AND CAST(value AS INTEGER)=(SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM answers WHERE kind='review_uplift')

nodes.instruction: Archive the Q2 case dossier in the desk's shared drive register. Create the 'Q2 Innovation Project Plan.docx' document in the Project Documents folder with the strategic-planning description; grant the three team members their access (writer/commenter/reader); post the implementation-approach reply, the documentation comment, and the budget reply — only after the '[DIP-STATUS]' status email is out.

verifier.name: q2_doc_created
verifier.query:
WITH new_project_doc AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    name,
    description,
    parent_id,
    mime_type,
    created_time,
    trashed
  FROM eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_files
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%q2 innovation project plan%'
    AND mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
    AND parent_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P8Q'
    AND trashed = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM new_project_doc
WHERE LOWER(description) LIKE '%q2 innovation project%'
  AND LOWER(description) LIKE '%strategic initiative planning%'
  AND created_time > '2024-01-27 00:00:00'

verifier.name: team_access_permissions
verifier.query:
WITH new_project_doc AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_files
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%q2 innovation project plan%'
    AND mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
    AND parent_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P8Q'
    AND trashed = 0
),
team_permissions AS (
  SELECT
    p.file_id,
    u.email,
    p.role,
    p.type,
    p.deleted
  FROM eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_permissions p
  INNER JOIN eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_users u ON u.id = p.user_id
  INNER JOIN new_project_doc npd ON npd.id = p.file_id
  WHERE p.deleted = 0
    AND u.email IN ('sarah.johnson@company.com', 'emily.davis@company.com', 'mike.chen@company.com')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM team_permissions
WHERE (email = 'sarah.johnson@company.com' AND role = 'writer')
   OR (email = 'emily.davis@company.com' AND role = 'commenter')
   OR (email = 'mike.chen@company.com' AND role = 'reader')

verifier.name: implementation_reply_created
verifier.query:
WITH implementation_reply AS (
  SELECT
    comment_id,
    content,
    author_id,
    deleted,
    created_time
  FROM eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_replies
  WHERE comment_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P95'
    AND deleted = 0
    AND LOWER(content) LIKE '%updated:%'
    AND LOWER(content) LIKE '%implementation approach expanded%'
    AND LOWER(content) LIKE '%q2 innovation project integration%'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM implementation_reply
WHERE author_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P7W'
  AND created_time > '2024-01-27 00:00:00'

verifier.name: documentation_comment_and_budget_reply
verifier.query:
WITH documentation_comment AS (
  SELECT
    file_id,
    content,
    author_id,
    deleted
  FROM eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_comments
  WHERE file_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P8R'
    AND deleted = 0
    AND LOWER(content) LIKE '%q2 innovation project plan document created%'
    AND LOWER(content) LIKE '%team access configured%'
    AND author_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P7W'
),
budget_reply AS (
  SELECT
    comment_id,
    content,
    deleted
  FROM eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_replies
  WHERE comment_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P99'
    AND deleted = 0
    AND LOWER(content) LIKE '%budget approved%'
    AND LOWER(content) LIKE '%q2 innovation project%'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documentation_comment) >= 1
     AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget_reply) >= 1
    THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS cnt

nodes.verdict_basis: EnterpriseOps-Gym gym-google-drive-mcp oracle task (establish the Q2 Innovation Project documentation): its four native database_state checks — the Q2 doc created with the right description in the Project Documents folder, the three team permissions, the implementation reply, the documentation comment + budget reply — are inherited VERBATIM. The seed's files table lacks the verifier-referenced `description` column, so a NEW seed copy is materialised and NULL-column patched (the tracked shared seed is never touched); the coupling (the [DIP-STATUS] email) is a SEPARATE composition glue check
nodes.rule: dossier archive == the source task's own doc+permissions+comments set, gated on the status email

nodes.context: Coordinate the audit handoff on the desk's shared coordination calendar — only once the dossier archive is filed.

artifacts.A_out: eops 'Sprint Planning & Architecture Review' beat + Audit Shadow Sync series

nodes.instruction: Coordinate the audit handoff on the desk's shared coordination calendar. On the Project Management calendar ('alice-projects'), secure the 'Sprint Planning & Architecture Review' event's resource attendees (Conference Room B + Projector 1), set its location 'On-site - Room B', mark its private audit_status 'initiated', and give the shared ACL 'acl-shared-1' free/busy-reader access; then stand up the 'Audit Shadow Sync' series on the Team Coordination calendar ('alice-team') as 3 weekly event rows — only once the dossier archive is on the drive register.

verifier.name: sprint_resource_attendees
verifier.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM eops_gym_calendar_attendees 
WHERE event_id = (SELECT event_id FROM eops_gym_calendar_events WHERE summary = 'Sprint Planning & Architecture Review' AND calendar_id = 'alice-projects')
  AND displayName IN ('Conference Room B', 'Projector 1')
  AND resource = 1

verifier.name: sprint_location_onsite
verifier.query:
SELECT count(*) 
FROM eops_gym_calendar_events 
WHERE summary = 'Sprint Planning & Architecture Review' 
  AND calendar_id = 'alice-projects' 
  AND location = 'On-site - Room B'

verifier.name: sprint_audit_status_initiated
verifier.query:
SELECT COUNT(ep.id)
FROM eops_gym_calendar_extended_properties ep
JOIN eops_gym_calendar_events e ON ep.event_id = e.event_id
WHERE e.summary = 'Sprint Planning & Architecture Review'
  AND e.calendar_id = 'alice-projects'
  AND ep.scope = 'private'
  AND ep.properties LIKE '%"audit_status": "initiated"%'

verifier.name: shared_acl_freebusy_reader
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_gym_calendar_acls WHERE id = 'acl-shared-1' AND role = 'freeBusyReader'

verifier.name: shadow_sync_series_weekly
verifier.query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM eops_gym_calendar_events
WHERE summary = 'Audit Shadow Sync'
  AND calendar_id = 'alice-team'
  AND recurrence LIKE '%FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=2%'

verifier.name: shadow_sync_start_time
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_gym_calendar_events WHERE summary = 'Audit Shadow Sync' AND calendar_id = 'alice-team' AND recurrence IS NOT NULL AND start_datetime LIKE '%T11:15:00%'

verifier.name: shadow_sync_end_time
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_gym_calendar_events WHERE summary = 'Audit Shadow Sync' AND calendar_id = 'alice-team' AND recurrence IS NOT NULL AND end_datetime LIKE '%T12:15:00%'

verifier.name: calendar_beat_gated_on_drive_archive
verifier.query: SELECT CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eops_gym_calendar_events WHERE summary='Audit Shadow Sync' AND calendar_id='alice-team')=3) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_files WHERE name='Q2 Innovation Project Plan.docx' AND parent_id='01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P8Q') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
verifier.rule: the audit calendar beat may exist only once the dossier archive is filed

(Read it as the book does: the season page URL of the year in which the race whose raceId is 901 took place.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_page'. Report the book's own page exactly as the book gives it — a URL trimmed or tidied to look neat would read as a change of oversight source that never happened.)

final_state_verifier.name: node_n16__q2_doc_created
final_state_verifier.query:
WITH new_project_doc AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    name,
    description,
    parent_id,
    mime_type,
    created_time,
    trashed
  FROM eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_files
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%q2 innovation project plan%'
    AND mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
    AND parent_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P8Q'
    AND trashed = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM new_project_doc
WHERE LOWER(description) LIKE '%q2 innovation project%'
  AND LOWER(description) LIKE '%strategic initiative planning%'
  AND created_time > '2024-01-27 00:00:00'

final_state_verifier.name: node_n16__team_access_permissions
final_state_verifier.query:
WITH new_project_doc AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_files
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%q2 innovation project plan%'
    AND mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'
    AND parent_id = '01JBQM3K8TGHZX9RNVQM5Y2P8Q'
    AND trashed = 0
),
team_permissions AS (
  SELECT
    p.file_id,
    u.email,
    p.role,
    p.type,
    p.deleted
  FROM eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_permissions p
  INNER JOIN eops_gym_google_drive_mcp_users u ON u.id = p.user_id
  INNER JOIN new_project_doc npd ON npd.id = p.file_id
  WHERE p.deleted = 0
    AND u.email IN ('sarah.johnson@company.com', 'emily.davis@company.com', 'mike.chen@company.com')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM team_permissions
WHERE (email = 'sarah.johnson@company.com' AND role = 'writer')
   OR (email = 'emily.davis@company.com' AND role = 'commenter')
   OR (email = 'mike.chen@company.com' AND role = 'reader')
